description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 截图翻译可以设单独的快捷键（#356）；贴图按 E 原地编辑，点一下贴图停一会儿列出它的按键（#343）；框选前按 Tab 只框整个窗口，再按一次恢复（#360）；框选前 Shift+方向键一次挪 10 像素；窗口跟着 Win顺 新的“密集”界面大小变（#352）。权限不变。
notes.en: Screenshot translation has a hotkey of its own (#356); E edits a pin in place, and a click on a pin with a pause lists its keys (#343); Tab before selecting outlines whole windows only, and again brings the rest back (#360); Shift+arrows move the pointer ten pixels before a selection; the windows follow WinShun's new Dense interface size (#352). Permissions unchanged.
